---
title: "Teaching"
---

My teaching philosophy centers on three core principles: grounding methods in real-world relevance, cultivating a safe and participatory learning space, and embracing a diversity of learning styles. 

I have been a teaching fellow in graduate-level quantitative courses primarily aimed at Master’s and PhD students in public health, as well as a tutor for students preparing for qualifying exams.
